title: dac12_fifo_sampletimegen
description: DAC12 sends a repetitive signal using FIFO and sample timer generator. The sample timer generator is configured to 16KSPS, so the output frequency will be 16KSPS / (Number of samples). The sine-wave contains 32 samples, resulting in 500Hz. The DAC is configured to use VDDA/VSSA as reference.
